reason: The expert clearly rejects the draft policy that each FY2025 measurement has exactly one applicable governing limit. Both tested constructions remove that rule, but they disagree on how to decide which limit rows belong to each measurement: keep the DMR-referenced limit join (824 pairs, 342 numeric comparisons) or enumerate every temporally overlapping permit limit for the same permit, outfall, and parameter (4,076 pairs, 1,388 numeric comparisons). Those are materially different outcomes on this fixture.
